content: Kasiimpo iaku kukamata saangu tanda momaoge inda momentela i laiana. Dhaangia pitu mia o malaaʼekati moumbaakana pitu angu balaa kapadhaa. Balaamo incia sii bhemomembalina kapadhaana pamuruna Aulataʼala.

Sapadhana sumai iaku kukamatamo saangu giu mboomo tawo minaaka i kaca mopojalona tee waa. Tee kukamata uka manga mia mopadhana motalona Binata Masega sumai tee patuna tee nomorona sarona akabhale-bhale i bhiwina tawo incia sumai. Manga incia akeni kecapi mopadhana idhawuakana Aulataʼala
tee alaguaka laguna Nabii Musa, bhatuana Aulataʼala, tee laguna Anana Dumba sumai. Mboo sii o laguna,

content.text: "E Aulataʼala, e Kawasana Opu Mokokuasana Mpuu,
Tapanamo kaoge tee inda amentela bhari-bharia ipewaumu!
Incema buaka inda momaekana tee Ingkoo,
tee inda momuliangina saromu, e Kawasana Opu?
roonamo bhari-bharia ipewaumu abanara tee atokamatamo i dunia."

content: Pitu Mia Malaaʼekati tee Pitu Angu Mangko Pamuruna Aulataʼala
Sapadhana sumai iaku kukamatamo uka Baitulla i sorogaa atobungkalemo, siitumo Kema Mangkilona Aulataʼala.

Minaaka i Baitulla sumai alimbamo pitu mia malaaʼekati mobhawana pitu angua balaa sumai. Manga incia apake kae lenan maputi momangkilo tee mokosilo, tee i badana manga incia uka apake salenda minaaka i bulawa.

Sala sambaa minaaka i pata mbaa mahaluku sumai adhawuaka pitu angu mangko bulawa i pitu miaia malaaʼekati sumai. Pitu angu mangko bulawa abukeaka pamuruna Aulataʼala, siitumo Aulataʼala modhadhina saʼumurua.

Baitulla sumai asalibumbungia ombuna kamuliangina Aulataʼala tee kuasana. Inda dhaangia o mia momembalina mopesuana i nuncana Baitulla sumai ande indapo pitu angua balaa minaaka i pitu miaia malaaʼekati sumai amapupu.
